items.q: What do you need from us for the X-ray?
items.a: One day, the people who do the work in one department, and the person who runs the systems. No data export before we meet.

items.q: Who should be in the room?
items.a: The owner or CEO for the opening and the closing. The head of the department and two people on the floor for the day. The CTO joins once the owner has said yes.
The process mapped in stations, the time per station, the hours a year, and every process ranked by payback with the first one to fix.

items.q: Can we stop after the X-ray?
items.a: Yes. You keep the map and the ranked list either way.
